name: ishti-whatsapp-bridge
description: Local WhatsApp bridge for ISHTI: pair once by scanning a QR code, then ISHTI reads and writes over a loopback HTTP API instead of driving Chrome.
comment: Pinned to the patched 6.7.22 line on purpose: 6.17.x is covered by GHSA-qvv5-jq5g-4cgg (zero-day, message spoofing) and 7.x is still a release candidate. Check npm for a newer patched 6.x before bumping.
